recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered outdoor portrait of a group, featuring a prominent foreground figure and a large-scale figure on the right, set against a rustic brick building and tall dry grass, with heavy geometric typography integrated into the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Text blocks overlapping the background and subjects to create depth
Foreground grass blades acting as a natural screen over the subjects
Scale contrast between the large figure on the right and smaller figures in the center-left
Horizontal alignment of the main title across the upper third
coreInvariants: Warm, desaturated color palette with brick reds and dry yellows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large figure dominates the right side; a second large figure is in the lower center foreground; three smaller figures occupy the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold white text in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold black 'IN', moves down to the white title, then follows the gaze of the right-hand figure toward the center group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, architecture, and tall grass.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy tones (brick red, tan, dry straw yellow) providing a warm base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and blacks in the clothing of the primary figures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white used for the primary title text to ensure legibility against the complex background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with high value contrast between the white text and the dark clothing/shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma synthetic colors

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a very tight aperture
The 'R' has a straight, diagonal leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family weight contrast (black vs. bold) or color contrast (black vs. white).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and mid-century aesthetic.
Provides the tight kerning and geometric purity seen in the 'O' and 'U'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an outdoor group portrait of five men in 1960s attire. One man is large in the right foreground, another in the lower center foreground. Three others are in the middle ground. The background is a weathered brick building with a blue door. Tall, dry, yellow grass blades should be in the immediate foreground, partially obscuring the figures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, all-caps geometric sans-serif text in the upper left. The first word should be black, and the subsequent words should be white, stacked and tightly spaced, overlapping the brick and the hair of the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the text heavy enough to dominate the upper left?
Does the foreground grass create a sense of depth?
Is the color palette warm and reminiscent of 1960s print?

adjustableVariables: Exact placement of the middle-ground figures
mustRedesign: Logos or specific brand marks in the corners
Exact facial features of the original subjects
Specific catalog numbers in the top right
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is all-caps and geometric
Ensure the right-side figure is significantly larger than the center-left group
Check that the grass blades appear in front of the subjects
Confirm the brick texture is visible behind the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Sans-Serif + Multi-Plane Outdoor Portrait + Foreground Foliage Screen + 1960s Warm Palette
